summary: Live blog of the first T20 international between West Indies and England in Barbados on 12-13 December 2023. England made 171 all out after being 77-0 after six overs and 112-2 after ten, then West Indies chased it down by 4 wickets with eleven balls remaining despite a rain interruption. Andre Russell, back after over two years, took 3-29 and hit 29* off 14 balls to win Player of the Match, and Rovman Powell also finished the chase strongly.
one_line: West Indies beat England by four wickets in the first T20I in Barbados, with Andre Russell's comeback bowling and finishing earning Player of the Match.
key_facts: England were 112-2 after ten overs but made only 59 runs off the next ten, losing eight wickets, to finish all out 171 with three balls to spare.
England had been 77-0 after six overs before West Indies turned the innings around.
West Indies won by 4 wickets with eleven balls remaining, taking a 1-0 lead in the series.
Andre Russell was Player of the Match after taking 3-29 and scoring 29* off 14 balls in his first T20I in over two years.
Russell hit the winning runs, a four off Sam Curran, and earlier hit a six off Adil Rashid.
West Indies hit fourteen sixes compared to England's six.
Adil Rashid took his 99th and 100th T20I wickets, dismissing Kyle Mayers and Shimron Hetmyer.
Rehan Ahmed finished with 3-39, including Shai Hope and Shepherd on consecutive balls, though his first over went for 19.
Rain stopped play at 108-4 after 12.4 overs, with West Indies six runs ahead of the Duckworth Lewis Stern rate; play restarted at 9.35pm with no overs lost.
Kyle Mayers made 35 and Brandon King 22 early in the chase; Shai Hope made 36.
Ben Duckett took a spectacular diving catch at backward point to dismiss Brandon King off Chris Woakes.
Tymal Mills returned to England's T20 side for the first time in eighteen months.
Rovman Powell hit consecutive sixes off Liam Livingstone and sixteen off Mills's 17th over.
The second match is in Grenada on Thursday.
